lines.en: I carry a golden shell, step by step.
My claws are big enough to drag.
The sand is soft. My footing holds.

lines.zh: 我在沙丘上巡自己的地盘。
lines.en: I patrol my dunes.
My shell's rim rasps the sand.
Eight legs, and still slow.

lines.zh: 我走到沙丘顶上看了一眼。
lines.en: I climb a dune and look about.
The gold shell glares in the sun.
I walk sideways, owning the flat.
My track is a deep groove.
A slit in my shell to watch the wind.

lines.zh: 沙丘的风把我的壳磨亮了。
lines.en: Dune wind polishes my shell.
I have lived in this shell for years.

lines.zh: 我在听沙子滑落的声音。
lines.en: I listen to sand sliding.

lines.zh: 王不需要站着，坐着也行。
lines.en: A king need not stand.
Cool inside, scorching outside.
I move when the sun drops.

lines.zh: 我的钳子搁在沙上，很沉。
lines.en: My claws rest heavy on the sand.
This sand answers to me.
I push my eyes through the slit.

lines.zh: 沙漠比海滩更干燥，我喜欢。
lines.en: Drier than the beach. I like it.

lines.zh: 我在数风里带过的沙粒。
lines.en: I count grains the wind carries.
Every scratch is an old fight.
I need no sleep, only guarding.
I sit steadier than the dune.
A lizard detours around me.
You are blocking my sun.
These are my dunes. Withdraw.
You have stared at my shell a while.
There is one king in this desert.

lines.zh: 你身上的水味，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell the water on you.
Do not walk in my track.
You are far smaller than I.

lines.zh: 我把钳子举起来，你就懂了。
lines.en: I raise a claw. You understand.

lines.zh: 这片滩，几百年没人敢来。
lines.en: No one dared this flat in centuries.

lines.zh: 沙做的壳，握着你的东西。
lines.en: This sand-built shell is holding what's yours.

lines.zh: 沙漠的白天很热，你会干。
lines.en: The day is hot. You will dry out.
The dune hears your steps before I do.
The sand-worn scar runs deeper.

lines.zh: 金壳震了一下，我还站着。
lines.en: My gold shell rang; I'm still up.
One claw hangs crooked.
I slap a dent in the sand.
It hurts. A king does not retreat.

lines.zh: 沙漠的金壳，比海滩的还厚。
lines.en: This desert gold shell outlasts the beach one.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，壳还对着你。
lines.en: One step back, shell still facing.
The echo in my shell goes dull.
You found a seam. Lucky.
Still here. Claws still up.
Fish? Where would fish come from?
Meat on sand will dry out.

lines.zh: 我不缺吃的，我缺的是安静。
lines.en: I lack quiet, not food.

lines.zh: 那块金，和我的壳一个色。
lines.en: That gold matches my shell.
Set it down and go ten paces back.

lines.zh: 你举得太高，是给鸟看的。
lines.en: Too high. That is for birds.
Water, now that I would take.
That will not buy a dune.

lines.zh: 别把食物扔进我的壳里。
lines.en: Do not throw food into my shell.
I can see your sincerity.

lines.zh: 撞上我的壳，你的膝盖疼吧。
lines.en: Hit my shell. Your knee hurts?
I walk sideways. You yield.
My shell presses dents in the sand.
I shove you onto the sand.
Do not walk beside my shell.
My shell is harder than sandstone.
One bump and you are covered in sand.

lines.zh: 沙漠里的金壳，比海滩的硬。
lines.en: Desert gold shell — harder than the beach's.
Keep your hand off my shell's rim.

lines.zh: 这一下，是我给你的警告。
lines.en: That was your warning.
A king needs no consort.
Many old shells lie under the dunes.

lines.zh: 这事得等潮水，可这里没有潮。
lines.en: That needs a tide. There is none.
A king's shell isn't lifted lightly.

lines.zh: 我的壳要留给下一个王。
lines.en: This shell is for the next king.
In this desert I know only myself.
Stop. The sand remembers.

lines.zh: 海滩那边的同类比我小。
lines.en: My beach kin are smaller.
I mind the dunes, not that.
Withdraw. The topic is closed.
What lies in the sand belongs to my shell.
I pinch it up with a claw.
Your dropped waterskin. Mine.
This gold suits my shell.
Three inches down is where it goes.
Bones under the sand I leave.
The waterskin leaks; the sand drinks it dry.
I snap your arrow and drop it.
My shell is already full.
Everything here has an owner.
I raise both claws.
You stand on my dune.
I accept this fight.
The sand shifts. That is me.
I mark your heels.
My shell's rim faces you. Stay back.
The sun is behind me. You are backlit.
I turn slowly and come sideways.
Your boots are sinking.
This clamp breaks bone.
No one comes to help out here.
I begin to move. Slowly.
The wind throws sand at your eyes.
This golden shell slows me down.
You have reached the dune's edge.
One step more and you are in reach.

lines.zh: 我压低了身子，沙下的壳在响。
lines.en: I crouch low; my shell scrapes under the sand.
Now I strike.
I sidestep in, a little at a time.
The dune gives me sure footing.

lines.zh: 你踩进了我钳子的范围。
lines.en: You stepped into my pincer's reach.
I need not run. You cannot run far.

lines.zh: 太阳在往下沉，你更慢了。
lines.en: The sun sinks and you slow.
My pincer aims at your ankle.
Wind piles sand at your feet.
I have walked this ground for years.

lines.zh: 你转身，我的壳正对着你。
lines.en: Turn, and my shell faces you.

lines.zh: 你听见壳沿拖沙的声音。
lines.en: Hear my shell dragging?

lines.zh: 沙漠的壳更厚，比海滩的硬。
lines.en: Desert shell is thicker than the beach kind.
Your hands are heavy now.

lines.zh: 我在等你脚陷得深一点。
lines.en: I wait for you to sink deeper.
No shade to hide in.
My claws outrange your sword.
You are drying out. I know.
I stop one step off. No hurry.
I raise my head and the wind drops.
One more block. Close enough.
Now the dune closes.
My claws close and your shield splits.
I lunge sideways and you leave the ground.

lines.zh: 金壳压下来，你喘不上气。
lines.en: The shell comes down. You cannot breathe.
The clamp lands on your calf.
Sand sprays from my claws.
You are dragged halfway into the sand.
The pincers close and sand flies.
Gold's too slick; your blade slips.
That puts you on your knees.

lines.zh: 我的钳子夹住了你的护腕。
lines.en: My claw catches your bracer.
Sand gets into the wound.
I withdraw, shell still forward.

lines.zh: 我背着金壳，钳子拖到沙上。
lines.en: Carrying this gold shell, my claw drags the sand.
That is the toll for my ground.
Sand slides off the dune's crest.

lines.zh: 金色的壳从沙里露出来。
lines.en: A gold shell surfaces from the sand.
The desert gains a king.

lines.zh: 风把我身上的沙吹掉了。
lines.en: Wind blows the sand off me.

lines.zh: 你听见钳子碰壳的声音。
lines.en: Claws clack against shell.
I rise and sand pours off.
This flat has an owner again.

lines.zh: 太阳照在我的壳上，很亮。
lines.en: Sun on my shell. Bright.
I crawl slowly out of the sand.
The sandstorm ends and I arrive.
No one has come here in centuries.
My shell stands taller than the dune.
A deep line scores the sand.
I begin patrolling my dunes.
Out of the sandstorm, gold shell and all.
You have disturbed my sand.
The dune moves—I rise.
This stretch belongs to the king.
My claws open for the first time.
Now get off my dune.

lines.zh: 沙漠的太阳都没烤焦我，你却想。
lines.en: The desert sun never did this.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘滚下去，壳朝下。
lines.en: I roll down the dune, shell first.
Water in my shell—sinking.
The blast throws up a wall of sand.
An arrow jams in a shell seam.
Magic stiffens my claws.
No food in the desert. I thin.

lines.zh: 雷击在壳上，金都发白了。
lines.en: Lightning whitens the gold.

lines.zh: 沙底开了个洞，下面是空。
lines.en: The sand opens. Below is nothing.
